Fast Travel to Orgrimmar with your Scroll of Retreat!


Orgrimmar is the capital city for the Horde and offers important services:

• Bank and Auction House
• Call Board
• Class Trainers, Profession Trainers, and Riding Trainers
• Flightmasters
• Vendors and more!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\57_2:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Navigating Through the City


Opening your Map inside the city will show POIs for important services and NPCs. Mouse over these icons to see their function.

The city may be large, but Orgrimmar Grunts can give you directions on where you need to go!

{page} {T:Interface\Tutorials\PtA\57_3:1024:406:1024:512:0:1024:59:465}

Report to High Warlord Saurfang


Heroes travel from the furthest reaches of Azeroth to seek comfort and companionship behind the mighty walls surrounding the city. The time has come for you to do the same, Hero.

Travel to the great warrior city of Orgrimmar and announce yourself to High Warlord Saurfang. He will be waiting to greet you inside the walls.
